company.name: Merlin AI
company.shortDescription: Merlin AI develops a AI-powered construction management software that helps with optimized operations.
company.description: Merlin AI provides an AI-driven ERP system for construction companies. The platform automates estimating, procurement, scheduling, and project tracking. It unifies project management, customer management, financials, and supply chain operations into one system. The system supports AI-powered cost estimation, supplier tracking, and automated purchase orders. It offers AI-driven scheduling and workforce coordination to manage tasks and timelines. The platform includes financial automation, reporting, and forecasting tools for budgets and risk management.
